data.name: Take Captive
data.description: While maintaining psionic focus, you can choose to deal nonlethal damage without incurring the -4 penalty on the attack rolls.  In addition, when you confirm a critical hit with an attack that deals nonlethal damage, you can expend your psionic focus to try to knock the enemy out, although a successful save (Fort DC %1) negates this effect.|TakeCaptiveDC
